Shai Hope Scores Century Against India in ODI Series

West Indies batsman Shai Hope scored a century against India in the ongoing series, hitting a six off the final ball to reach the milestone. This marked his fourth century of the tour and placed him in an elite club with cricketers like Chris Gayle and Virat Kohli, while also drawing comparisons to Sahibzada Farhan's achievements. The century also saw Hope set several new records.
